mainText: Hello, Verona! At 5 PM, here is today's balanced dish. It is a clear 73 degrees at Reddan Soccer Park. Tonight, the temperature drops to 55 degrees with no rain in the forecast. We are under a Waxing Gibbous moon, and the ISS will be visible at 4:11 AM, rising in the west over Mount Horeb and heading toward Madison near the Home Depot, reaching halfway up the sky.

The City of Verona is currently seeking an Engineering Technician to manage municipal projects, with applications accepted until September 20. Additionally, the city is offering a 30 dollar rebate for residents who install rain barrels to help with stormwater management.

Today, you can check out live music at Bailey's Run or Wisconsin Brewing Company, and youth can participate in a free Girls Try Hockey event at the Verona Ice Arena. Tomorrow, look for yoga sessions at Insight Wellness.

On Friday, August 15, officers were dispatched to the Westridge Estates neighborhood after receiving a report of a missing 7-year-old child, who was safely located and reunited with their parents shortly after.
Stop by Culver's today to enjoy the Caramel Cashew flavor of the day; they are open until 10 PM. You can also catch Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today between 11 AM and 5 PM.
